title: 1st Convocation Ceremony 2025 | KPGU
content: rar (In-Charge) Expressing sincere gratitude, Dr. Nagda thanked the Hon ble Chief Guest, Guests of Honour, and dignitaries for their august presence. He conveyed heartfelt appreciation to the parents, faculty members, staff, and the entire KPGU fraternity for their contributions in making the First Convocation Ceremony a grand success.
